build_Runner_from_cfg: build a Runner from a config dict with model, work_dir, train_dataloader, and optim_wrapper
run_Runner_train: run training by calling runner.train() to launch the training loop with hooks and checkpointing
run_Runner_val: run validation by calling runner.val() to evaluate the model on the validation set
run_Runner_test: run testing by calling runner.test() to evaluate the model on the test set
resume_Runner_checkpoint: resume training from a checkpoint file using runner.resume() with optimizer and param scheduler state
